The ordinary scanning backlog is 1,320 records. Each technician completes 35 records per day, and there are four technicians. Over six days, the total number of records completed is 4 technicians * 35 records/technician/day * 6 days = 840 records. Therefore, the remaining number of records in the ordinary backlog after six days is 1,320 records - 840 records = 480 records.
